rule: Champion ladder: each kill counts toward a kill target that depends on the level band (256, 128, 64, 32, 16). A white skull is placed per 20 percent of the target; at 99 percent the level advances and the expiry clock resets. At the rolled max level the champion spawns. On expiry with no skull the level drops one step (stop at zero if not always-active); otherwise skulls clear and the level holds. Spawn cap is 250 minus 40 per sub-level. A daily timer makes one random idle spawn per group ready. Harrower: a summoned boss with a 30000 first form; death is intercepted and it morphs to 65000 with nine tentacles in a ring; a teleport-pull every five seconds at a 25 percent roll; a gold spill at its true-form death with random per-pile delays. One Harrower at a time.
